meta.name: security-audit
meta.description: Deep security audit covering OWASP Top 10, authentication, authorization, data protection, dependency vulnerabilities, and secrets scanning. Delegates to the Centinela (QA) agent.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扫描代码中的安全漏洞与配置风险
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在发布前发现并修复安全漏洞。
copy.tagline_en: Scan code for security vulnerabilities and configuration risks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to find and fix security vulnerabilities before release.

howto.what: 深度安全审计:按 OWASP Top 10 检查,扫描密钥与依赖漏洞,有 Solidity 时查智能合约;输出报告到 docs/reviews/security-audit-{date}.md,交给 Dev 代理;只记录,不修复。
howto.when: 输入 /security-audit(可加目录限定范围)时触发;常见用途是发布前、涉认证/授权/数据处理的代码改动后,或新增依赖时。未指定范围默认审计整个 src/。

say.note: 默认审计整个 src/ 目录。
同时审计登录与接口模块。

howto.what_en: Deep security audit via Centinela: OWASP Top 10, secrets, dependency CVEs, Solidity contracts if present; writes verdict/report to docs/reviews/security-audit-{date}.md and hands to Dev agent. Documents only, never fixes.
howto.when_en: Triggered by /security-audit (optionally with paths). Use cases: pre-release, auth/authz/data changes, or adding dependencies. Without a path, audits the whole src/ directory.

say_en.note: Audits the whole src/ directory by default.
Restricts the audit to the payments directory.
Audits auth and API modules together.
